findings.text: follow-on: authored_plan_text still decomposes every section[data-reckon='section'] element, so a plan that wraps a data-reckon='section' authored section has its prose dropped from read_plan(search=...) and discovery search even though this change now lets that same section be read and collapsed by id, leaving the search surface inconsistent with the read surface.
